info.description:
This course consists of 6 Units focusing on different genres related to anthropology, history, journalism, psychology, and urban study. In each unit, students will learn structure of paragraphs of different genres such as descriptive, process, narrative, opinion and how to use grammar as well as vocabulary appropriately

Each Unit includes 5 parts namely Stimulating Ideas, Brainstorming and Outlining, Developing ideas, Editing your writing, and Review.
